name: @defold-typescript/docs-site
description: Static documentation site for defold-typescript, rendering the guide to HTML.

scripts.build-indexes: bun ../docs-render/scripts/write-critical-css.ts public && bun scripts/build-guide-images.ts && bun run --cwd ../docs-render build-font-fallbacks && bun scripts/build-changelog-dates.ts && bun scripts/build-search-index.ts && bun scripts/build-symbol-index.ts && bun scripts/build-llms.ts
scripts.build:site: bun run build-indexes && vite build --mode client && vite build
